title: Benny the Bear’s Cozy Day
subtitle: A Bold & Easy Color & Read Story Book for Kids Ages 3-6
summary: Pancakes, a kite, hide and seek and a bedtime story.
story: It’s a brand new day, and Benny can’t wait to play. He eats pancakes, meets his best friend Bella the bunny, listens to a story from Ollie the owl, has a picnic, flies a kite high in the sky, and snuggles up for a cozy bedtime story with Mama Bear.
highlights: 27 full-page pictures that tell one sweet story
Bold, thick lines that are easy to color
One short sentence in big, clear letters on every page
A “This book belongs to” page for gifting
cover_alt: Cover of Benny the Bear’s Cozy Day: Benny and Bella the bunny have a picnic with a honey pot

inside.text: Benny and Bella have a picnic under a tree.
They fly a kite high up in the sky.
Bath time! Benny loves big bubbles.

colored.text: They fly a kite high up in the sky.
